titolo: ByteDance unveils Mixture-of-Loops Transformer achieving 1.7× token efficiency
descr: The new MoLT model uses KV memory across loops, boosting pre‑training efficiency and matching OLMo3 latency.
paragrafi: ByteDance researchers introduced the Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), a looped Transformer that reuses keys and values as memory across depths and loops.

MoLT features Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) and two variants: MoLT‑R, which keeps the residual stream, and MoLT‑KV, which restarts from embeddings and reads current‑loop KV together with prior‑loop memory for efficiency.
In 400 B‑token pre‑training, U‑MoLT delivered 1.7× validation cross‑entropy token efficiency for 700 M models and lowered perplexity and task accuracy gaps for 3 B MoE models.
During inference, U‑MoLT with MoL‑Hybrid‑2 matched non‑looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 ms versus 1,000.6 ms on S‑size (~113 M) models. The code is released on GitHub.
perche: For AI practitioners, MoLT offers a path to faster, more efficient training without sacrificing accuracy, which can lower compute costs. For users of free or locally‑run models, the open‑source release may enable smaller deployments to benefit from looped‑Transformer efficiencies.
